semiconductor_relevance: High — Sensor System Technology specializes in pressure and control sensors which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sensor System Technology Co., Ltd. (Sensys) is a leading provider of pressure sensors, level sensors, temperature sensors, and digital indicators, primarily serving the semiconductor industry. Established in 1998, the company is committed to research and development to enhance customer satisfaction and product quality.

regional_presence.Korea: Sensys is recognized as a leading company in Korea within the sensor technology sector.
